INTERFACE DESIGN AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made on 2 February 2026 between Northwind Instruments Incorporated, a corporation organised under the laws of the State of Delaware, with offices at 300 Hudson Street, New York, New York 10013 (the "Client"), and Aoife Doyle, trading as Doyle Interface, of 51 Abbot Street, Brooklyn, New York 11222 (the "Contractor").

The parties agree as follows.

1. THE ENGAGEMENT

1.1 The Contractor shall design the mobile application interface described in Schedule 1 (the "Deliverables").
1.2 The Contractor shall begin work on 9 February 2026 and shall deliver the last of the Deliverables by 22 May 2026 (the "Term").
1.3 The Contractor shall perform the Services with reasonable skill and care.
1.4 This Agreement does not renew, and any further engagement of the Contractor requires a fresh written agreement signed by both parties.

2. HOW THE WORK IS DELIVERED

2.1 The Contractor shall deliver each Deliverable to the Client by the date shown against it in Schedule 1.
2.2 The Contractor shall deliver each Deliverable as a source design file together with an exported specification for the engineering team.
2.3 The Contractor shall carry out two rounds of revisions to each Deliverable at no additional charge.

3. CHANGES

3.1 A change to the Deliverables, to the Term or to the fee takes effect only once both parties have signed a written change order recording it.
3.2 Neither party may vary the fee or the scope of the Deliverables without the other party's written agreement.

4. FEES, ACCEPTANCE AND PAYMENT

4.1 The Client shall pay the Contractor a fixed fee of $24,000 for the Deliverables, invoiced in four equal instalments.
4.2 The Client shall notify the Contractor in writing within five (5) business days of delivery whether a Deliverable meets the acceptance criteria in Schedule 2, identifying by reference to those criteria anything that does not.
4.3 A Deliverable is treated as accepted if the Client gives no notice under clause 4.2 within that period.
4.4 The Client shall pay each invoice within twenty-one (21) days of the date of the invoice.

5. CONFIDENTIALITY

5.1 Each party shall keep confidential the other party's commercial and technical information disclosed to it under this Agreement, and shall use that information only for the purposes of this Agreement.
5.2 Clause 5.1 does not apply to information that is already public or that a party is required by law to disclose.

6. STATUS OF THE CONTRACTOR

6.1 The Contractor is an independent contractor and nothing in this Agreement makes the Contractor an employee, agent or partner of the Client.
6.2 The Contractor decides how and when to carry out the work, subject only to the delivery dates in Schedule 1.

7. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

7.1 On payment in full for a Deliverable, the Contractor assigns to the Client all intellectual property rights in that Deliverable.
7.2 The assignment in clause 7.1 covers the Deliverables and also reaches the Contractor's pre-existing tools, components and methods, whether or not they were created for the Client, and any work of a similar character that the Contractor may produce after this Agreement ends.
7.3 The Contractor shall sign any document the Client reasonably requires in order to record the rights assigned under this clause 7.

8. INDEMNITY AND LIABILITY

8.1 Each party shall indemnify the other against any claim brought by a third party to the extent that the claim arises from that party's own breach of this Agreement.
8.2 The total liability of each party under this Agreement is limited to the total fees payable under clause 4.
8.3 Nothing in this Agreement limits either party's liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, or for fraud.

9. ENDING THIS AGREEMENT

9.1 Either party may end this Agreement by giving the other twenty-one (21) days' written notice.
9.2 Where the Client ends this Agreement under clause 9.1, the Client shall pay for every Deliverable accepted or delivered before the end date, for work in progress on the date of the notice, and a cancellation fee of twenty per cent (20%) of the fees for the work not yet started.
9.3 Clauses 5, 7 and 8 survive the end of this Agreement.

10. AFTER THE TERM

10.1 Neither party restricts the other from working with any client, customer or supplier after the end of this Agreement.

11. NOTICES

11.1 A notice under this Agreement must be in writing and sent to the address shown at the head of this Agreement or to an email address the receiving party has given for the purpose.

12. GOVERNING LAW

12.1 This Agreement and any dispute arising out of or in connection with it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, and the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts sitting in New York County.

13. WHOLE AGREEMENT

13.1 This Agreement is the whole agreement between the parties about the Deliverables and replaces any earlier proposal, quotation or discussion.

SCHEDULE 1 — THE DELIVERABLES

Item 1: Interface audit of the current application, due 27 February 2026.
Item 2: Navigation and information architecture, due 20 March 2026.
Item 3: Screen designs for the twelve core flows, due 24 April 2026.
Item 4: Component specification and handover, due 22 May 2026.

SCHEDULE 2 — ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA

A Deliverable meets the acceptance criteria when all four of the following are true.
Criterion 1: Every screen is supplied at the three breakpoints listed in the Client's platform note.
Criterion 2: Every component maps to a named entry in the Client's existing design system, or is documented as a new component.
Criterion 3: Text contrast meets WCAG 2.2 AA on every screen supplied.
Criterion 4: The exported specification names the source file and the version it was taken from.

Signed for and on behalf of Northwind Instruments Incorporated.

Signed by Aoife Doyle, trading as Doyle Interface.
